rotation_principles: Never plant the same crop family in the same bed two cycles in a row to prevent pest and disease buildup in soil.
Follow Heavy Feeders with Light Feeders, then Soil Builders (Legumes), and finally Cover Crops / Green Manures.
Always leave legume root systems in the soil upon harvest—cut tops at ground level so nitrogen nodules rot in place.

standard_4_stage_cycle.name: Heavy Feeders (Calorie Maximizers)
standard_4_stage_cycle.soil_demand: High nitrogen and high organic matter demand.
standard_4_stage_cycle.input_protocol: Bed freshly enriched with 2 bucketfuls of compost + 1 handful of roasted bone meal per pace.
standard_4_stage_cycle.outcome: Massive initial harvest; depletes surplus soil nitrogen.

standard_4_stage_cycle.name: Light Feeders (Scavengers & Greens)
standard_4_stage_cycle.soil_demand: Moderate nutrients; thrives on residual organic matter without extra heavy fertilization.
standard_4_stage_cycle.input_protocol: Top-dress with two fingers of dry leaf mulch and a light dusting of cold wood ash.
standard_4_stage_cycle.outcome: Steady continuous green harvest; prevents excessive leafy vegetative growth.

standard_4_stage_cycle.name: Soil Builders & Nitrogen Fixers (The Rechargers)
standard_4_stage_cycle.soil_demand: Low nitrogen demand. Synthesizes nitrogen from atmospheric air into root nodules.
standard_4_stage_cycle.input_protocol: Needs only loose soil and moderate moisture. Add half a handful of crushed bone meal for root growth.
standard_4_stage_cycle.outcome: Produces edible protein pods while pumping biological nitrogen back into the root zone.

standard_4_stage_cycle.name: Restoration Cover Crop / Green Manure
standard_4_stage_cycle.input_protocol: Broadcast seeds densely across the bed surface. Let grow until knee-high.
standard_4_stage_cycle.outcome: Chop and drop technique: chop down before seed sets, lay directly on bed as decomposing green blanket.

pioneer_cover_crops.name: Wild White Clover / Vetch
pioneer_cover_crops.purpose: Nitrogen fixation and weed suppression carpet
pioneer_cover_crops.harvest_method: Chop stems at knee-high and lay flat on the bed; do not dig out roots.

pioneer_cover_crops.name: Wild Mustard Cover
pioneer_cover_crops.purpose: Biofumigation of soil pests and deep sulfur mining
pioneer_cover_crops.harvest_method: Tear and trample into the top two fingers of soil to release natural fumigating mustard oils.

pioneer_cover_crops.name: Fast Buckwheat
pioneer_cover_crops.purpose: Rapid weed smothering and phosphorus mobilization
pioneer_cover_crops.harvest_method: Scrape down at flowering; hollow succulent stems decompose into soft humus within 10 suns.
